referenceFunction.generalComment: This dataset describes the production of an insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) used in the power electronics of electric vehicles. It is based on the direct inspection of a commercial device.; UUID: acba1dd1-2c49-3467-8a40-32d2f410cf05
